title: Boxing
description:
Boxing is the original striking art. Built on footwork, head movement, timing, and precision punching. It's one of the oldest combat sports in the world, and remains one of the most demanding disciplines for building hand speed, conditioning, and defensive instincts. For MMA athletes, a strong boxing foundation is often what separates a good striker from a great one.

In our boxing classes, you'll train the fundamentals: stance, footwork, jab-cross combinations, head movement, slipping and rolling, and counter-punching, before progressing into more advanced combinations and pad work. Classes blend technical instruction with pad drills, bag work, and controlled sparring so you can develop real fight-ready skills in a structured, safety-first environment.

Whether you're an MMA fighter looking to add crisp hands to your game, or someone who's never thrown a punch and wants a serious full-body workout, our coaches meet you where you are. Expect to sweat, build explosive power, and leave every class sharper than you walked in.

Classes typically include a dynamic warm-up, technique breakdown, mitt/pad work, and rounds on the bag or with a partner. Gloves and wraps are all you need to get started.
excerpt: Build fast, technical striking through classic fundamentals and high-intensity training.
